answer: Each new identity needs four endorsements from established neighbors staking 40 each. A jade seal ties each endorsement to one key; borrowed seals cannot be reused. A rented-neighbor ring's fable fails when two endorsements share one key. Neighbors near the zenith may vouch; backing a fake loses 40 and burns the fake's 70-credit bond. Forging 1,000 costs 1,000 x 230 = 230,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its share.
